q: What is meant by 'associated finance' in Indian Railways?

options.A: The system of obtaining the FA&CAO's financial concurrence on executive proposals
options.B: A loan taken from the Ministry of Finance
options.C: A joint bank account operated by two departments
options.D: The statutory audit conducted by the CAG

q: Financial concurrence at the zonal railway level is rendered by whom?
The primary purpose of the associated finance system is to ensure what?

options.C: Financial scrutiny of proposals before sanction

q: Associated finance operates at which stage of a proposal?
Finance concurrence is generally required on proposals involving what?
The financial adviser and chief accounts officer of a zone is designated as what?
Associated finance is best described as which of the following?

options.C: Internal financial advice within the railway

q: Finance concurrence on a proposal is recorded in what form?
Which of the following is NOT an object of financial concurrence?
'Regularity' as an object of financial concurrence means conformity with what?
'Propriety' in financial scrutiny requires expenditure to satisfy which test?

options.C: It must meet standards of financial propriety and public interest

q: 'Economy' as an object of financial concurrence means what?
'Efficiency' in financial concurrence is concerned with what?

options.A: Achieving objectives with optimum use of resources

q: Which four canons together guide financial concurrence in railways?
Financial concurrence secures value for money mainly through which objects?
Finance concurrence is required before sanctioning which of the following?
Workshop schemes involving fresh expenditure need the concurrence of whom?
Purchase proposals beyond an officer's delegated powers need what before acceptance?
Proposals for creation of new posts require finance concurrence because they create what?
Material variations in a sanctioned estimate generally call for what?
Write-off of losses of railway money or stores requires what?
Which of the following does NOT normally need fresh finance concurrence?
Internal check in Indian Railways is exercised by whom?
Statutory external audit of railway accounts is conducted by whom?

options.C: The Comptroller and Auditor General of India

q: Internal check is essentially which kind of control?

options.B: A continuous check exercised by the Accounts department

q: Unlike internal check, external audit is mainly concerned with what?
Objections raised during internal check are pursued through what?

options.D: The objection book and objection statements

q: Internal check is applied to transactions at what point of time?
While scrutinising an estimate, finance verifies the reasonableness of what?
During estimate scrutiny, finance checks availability of funds and what else?
Scrutiny of an estimate includes checking the correctness of what?

options.A: The basis of rates and quantities

q: Finance may suggest cheaper alternatives during scrutiny in order to secure what?
An estimate inflated without justification should be dealt with how?

options.B: Returned to the executive for justification or revision

q: Finance concurrence on an estimate is based on what?

options.A: The documents and data furnished with the proposal

q: The provision for contingencies in an estimate is meant for what?

options.D: Unforeseen items incidental to the work

q: Propriety audit examines whether expenditure conforms to what?
Under the canons of propriety, public money must not be spent for whose advantage?

options.C: The personal advantage of the sanctioning authority

q: The canons of propriety expect every officer to exercise whose vigilance?

options.B: The vigilance of a person of ordinary prudence spending their own money

q: Expenditure that is prima facie more than the occasion demands offends which canon?
Propriety audit goes beyond legality and examines what?

options.A: The wisdom and faithfulness of the expenditure

q: Sanctioning expenditure that benefits a contractor at public cost is what?
The canons of financial propriety bind whom?

options.B: Every officer incurring or authorising expenditure

q: Finance is consulted at the indent stage mainly to verify what?

options.D: The need, specification and availability of funds

q: At the tender stage, finance advises on the comparative statement and what else?
Financial advice on tenders helps ensure acceptance of which offer?
If tender rates appear unreasonably high, finance may advise what?
Finance vets tender conditions to ensure they do what?
Vetting of the draft supply order by finance ensures agreement with what?

options.D: The accepted offer and the sanction

q: When finance withholds concurrence, what must it do?

options.B: Record the reasons for withholding in writing

q: If finance withholds concurrence, what course is open to the executive?

options.C: Represent the case to the higher competent authority

q: Overruling of finance advice requires the orders of whom?
Withholding of financial concurrence is best regarded as what?

options.D: A financial safeguard exercised in public interest

q: Cases in which finance advice is overruled should be dealt with how?
Delegation of financial powers means what?

options.A: Authority to sanction expenditure conferred on subordinate authorities

q: Delegated financial powers are exercisable subject to what?

options.C: Conditions such as finance concurrence and funds availability

q: A subordinate authority must not sanction expenditure that is what?
Where prescribed, delegated powers must be exercised with what?
Deliberately splitting a sanction to remain within delegated powers is what?
In a railway workshop, the accounts organisation is headed by whom?
The workshop accounts officer renders what on workshop proposals?
Workshop accounts maintains cost records of what?
Internal check in workshops covers which transactions?

options.D: Stores transactions, expenditure and suspense balances

q: Proposals for manufacture in workshops need finance vetting of what?
Before an overhaul programme is approved, finance examines what?
Finance concurrence on workshop schemes ensures what before commitment?
Expenditure incurred without the sanction of the competent authority is what?
The 'competent authority' for a sanction means which authority?

options.B: The authority empowered under the rules to accord it

q: An ex-post-facto sanction is one that is accorded when?

options.A: After the expenditure has been incurred

q: Financial irregularities noticed during internal check are recorded in what?
The objection book is maintained for what purpose?

options.A: Watching and pursuing settlement of objections
